title: Russian Pilaf
description: A hearty and comforting dish originating from Russia, made with pilaf and a hint of grape.
instructions: Heat the chicken fat in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced red onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the pilaf and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the pan with a lid.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped grapes before serving.
